# Bell Enviro

> Principal-delivered environmental consultancy based in the Darwin rural area (Humpty Doo), Northern Territory, Australia. Serves civil head contractors, subcontractors, developers and interstate consultancies with contaminated land and PFAS investigations, construction environmental management plans (CEMPs), environmental audits and inspections, environmental approvals, cultural heritage/AAPA coordination and a retainer 'environmental department as a service'. Fixed-price packages. Principal: Chris Bell. Phone 0424 577 159. Email chris@bellenviro.au.

Service regions in priority order: (1) Darwin, Palmerston and the Litchfield rural area; (2) the Top End including Katherine, Kakadu/Jabiru, Arnhem Land, Nhulunbuy and the Tiwi Islands; (3) the wider Northern Territory and the East Kimberley region of Western Australia (Kununurra, Wyndham, Halls Creek).

## Services
- [Contaminated land assessment — PSI and DSI](https://bellenviro.au/services/contaminated-land-assessment/): NEPM-aligned preliminary and detailed site investigations (PSI/DSI) in Darwin, Palmerston and across the NT. Fixed-price, principal-delivered reports accepted by NT EPA and auditors.
- [PFAS testing, investigation and management](https://bellenviro.au/services/pfas-investigation/): PFAS soil, groundwater and surface water investigations in Darwin and the NT, delivered to the PFAS National Environmental Management Plan. Sampling, waste classification and management plans for civil works.
- [Environmental management plans (CEMPs) and ESCPs](https://bellenviro.au/services/construction-environmental-management-plan/): Contract-ready CEMPs, erosion and sediment control plans, weed hygiene and dust/noise plans for NT Government, Defence and council civil works. Fixed price, fast turnaround, Darwin-based.
- [Environmental auditing, inspections and compliance](https://bellenviro.au/services/environmental-auditing-compliance/): ISO 19011-based environmental audits, site compliance inspections, monitoring programs and incident reporting systems for civil works in Darwin and across the NT.
- [Environmental approvals, NT EPA referrals and permits](https://bellenviro.au/services/environmental-approvals/): NT EPA referrals, environment protection licences, land clearing and water approvals, and statutory environmental compliance advice for projects in Darwin, the Top End and the NT.
- [Your environmental department, as a service](https://bellenviro.au/services/environmental-department-as-a-service/): A monthly retainer giving NT civil contractors standing environmental advice, document review, incident support and priority delivery of CEMPs, audits and investigations, without hiring an environmental officer.
- [Cultural heritage assessment and AAPA clearance coordination](https://bellenviro.au/services/cultural-heritage-aapa/): Cultural heritage assessment, Aboriginal Areas Protection Authority (AAPA) certificate coordination, Traditional Owner engagement and archaeological survey support for projects in the NT.
- [Compliance, stockpile and incident registers](https://bellenviro.au/services/compliance-registers/): Practical obligations, stockpile and incident register systems for mid-tier civil contractors, set up and maintained by Bell Enviro so compliance evidence is ready when the auditor or principal asks.
- [Asbestos testing, registers and hazardous materials surveys](https://bellenviro.au/services/asbestos-hazmat-darwin/): Asbestos sampling and NATA-accredited identification, asbestos registers and management plans, pre-demolition hazmat surveys and Class B clearance inspections in Darwin, Palmerston and the NT. Licensed assessors engaged for friable and Class A works.
- [Soil testing in Darwin and the Top End](https://bellenviro.au/services/soil-testing-darwin/): Soil testing and sampling in Darwin, Palmerston and the rural area: contamination screening, waste classification for fill and excavated material, PFAS, acid sulfate soils and asbestos in soil. NATA-accredited laboratories, interpreted results.
- [Bore water, surface water and discharge testing in Darwin](https://bellenviro.au/services/water-testing-darwin/): Bore water, surface water, groundwater, dewatering and discharge sampling in Darwin, Palmerston and the rural area, with NATA-accredited analysis and interpreted results against drinking water, irrigation and NT EPA criteria.

## Regions
- [Environmental consultant for Darwin, Palmerston and the rural area](https://bellenviro.au/regions/darwin-palmerston-rural/): Darwin-based environmental consultant servicing Darwin, Palmerston, Humpty Doo, Howard Springs, Berry Springs, Noonamah, Coolalinga and the Litchfield rural area. Contaminated land, PFAS, CEMPs, audits and approvals.
- [Environmental consultant for the Top End](https://bellenviro.au/regions/top-end/): Remote-capable environmental consultant for the Top End of the Northern Territory: Katherine, Kakadu and Jabiru, West and East Arnhem Land, Nhulunbuy, the Tiwi Islands, Daly River and the Victoria River district.
- [Environmental consultant across the Northern Territory and the Kimberley](https://bellenviro.au/regions/northern-territory-kimberley/): Environmental consulting across the Northern Territory and north-eastern Western Australia, including Tennant Creek, Alice Springs, the Barkly, Kununurra, Wyndham, Halls Creek and the East Kimberley.

## Guides
- [Do I need a CEMP for NT Government or Defence civil works?](https://bellenviro.au/guides/do-i-need-a-cemp-for-nt-government-works/): When a Construction Environmental Management Plan is required on NT Government, Defence and council contracts, what it must contain, and how to get it approved quickly.
- [PSI vs DSI: which contaminated land assessment do you need in the NT?](https://bellenviro.au/guides/psi-vs-dsi-contaminated-land-nt/): The difference between a Preliminary Site Investigation and a Detailed Site Investigation under the ASC NEPM, when each is needed in the Northern Territory, and what they cost.
- [PFAS testing for civil works around Darwin: what contractors need to know](https://bellenviro.au/guides/pfas-testing-civil-works-darwin/): Where PFAS is a concern for civil works in Darwin, when excavated soil needs testing, and how the PFAS NEMP affects reuse and disposal of material.
- [Weed hygiene declarations for NT civil works: what is required](https://bellenviro.au/guides/weed-hygiene-declaration-nt/): What a weed hygiene declaration is, when NT Government and land council contracts require one, and how to set up wash-down and inspection procedures that pass audit.
- [NT EPA referral: when a project needs one and how the process works](https://bellenviro.au/guides/nt-epa-referral/): When a project must be referred to the NT Environment Protection Authority under the Environment Protection Act 2019, how the pre-referral screening tool works, what a referral contains and how long assessment takes.
- [Land clearing permits in the NT: when you need one and how to apply](https://bellenviro.au/guides/land-clearing-permit-nt/): When native vegetation clearing in the Northern Territory needs a permit under the Planning Act, what the Land Clearing Guidelines require, exemptions, and how to prepare an application that gets approved.
- [AAPA Authority Certificates: what they are, when you need one and how long they take](https://bellenviro.au/guides/aapa-certificate-nt/): How Aboriginal Areas Protection Authority (AAPA) Authority Certificates work in the Northern Territory, why most government and Defence contracts require one, the application process, cost and timing.
- [Gamba grass and weed management plans for Darwin rural properties and civil sites](https://bellenviro.au/guides/gamba-grass-management-plan/): Gamba grass obligations for landholders and contractors in the Darwin region, what a weed management plan under the NT Weeds Management Act must contain, and how to meet the requirements practically.
